observations.body: God judges between sheep, saves the flock, appoints one shepherd “my servant David,” makes a covenant of peace, removes danger, sends blessing, and names the people as his flock.

payload.posture: Read Ezekiel 34:20–31 as its own royal, poetic, and prophetic memory David setting before carrying its language into another source.
